description: The top of the ladder, over a WORK (ordered passages) and a CORPUS (works): theme (recurrent matter), leitmotif (recurrent concrete vehicle), structure (sequence-shape), worldview (fixed-point invariant frame), genre (cross-work centroid). One move re-pointed: recurrence, sequence-displacement, fixed-point, cross-tier centroid.

attrs.name: theme
attrs.description: Order-N over a WORK, beside VOICE but pointed at MATTER not manner: voice is the centroid of the displacement OPERATOR (the how), theme is the centroid of the operator ENDPOINTS in referent-space (the what-about). A recurrence cluster over the passage referents; theme = the referent-axis recurring across the most passages. Holds iff carried by MORE THAN ONE VOICE (else it is just a voice signature) and excising it drops the work referent-coherence.

attrs.name: leitmotif
attrs.description: The same recurrence as THEME but one level DOWN, on concrete FIGURE objects not abstract referents: the literal recurring VEHICLE — a figure/image whose instances are near-copies (low intra-cluster displacement, intertext-translations within one work), bound by points_to to the THEME it carries. Theme survives paraphrase; a leitmotif is the concrete thing that keeps showing up to mean it, accruing stance each return.

attrs.name: structure
attrs.description: ANALYSIS re-pointed one level UP: the displacement primitive applied to the SEQUENCE of passage-trajectories. A bag of trajectories has no order; structure is the shape of the trajectory-of-trajectories — the displacement between consecutive passages, classified as rising / falling / arc / ring. Holds iff PERMUTATION-SENSITIVE: shuffle the passages and the shape signature breaks (invariance-to-reorder would prove there is no structure).

attrs.name: worldview
attrs.description: The FIXED-POINT of the work entire operator-family: the assumption-frame every voice/theme/structure presupposes and none displaces. Found by relax_to_fixpoint — apply the work operators until something stops moving; the conserved coordinate frame all axes measure FROM but never move IS the worldview. Holds iff applying any operator returns it unchanged (zero displacement); a passage that DOES displace it is a worldview crack — a contradiction, the falsifier.

attrs.name: genre
attrs.description: Genre is to WORKS what VOICE is to passages: the invariant operator across a CORPUS. A cross-work centroid+spread over whole works reduced to their (structure-shape, theme-axis, worldview-frame) signatures; genre = prototype + admissible spread (family resemblance, a Beta/CI region). A new work is in-genre iff its signature falls inside the spread; cross-genre/parody lifts the INTERTEXT off-domain move one rung up (one genre operator applied to another genre matter).

attrs.name: theme_voice_independence
attrs.head: work/corpus understanding
attrs.body: a theme must be carried by more than one voice; a recurring referent in a single voice is a voice signature, not a theme

attrs.name: leitmotif_small_displacement
attrs.head: work/corpus understanding
attrs.body: leitmotif instances translate onto each other with small displacement (the same concrete vehicle, not a paraphrase) and each co-occurrence carries the theme referent

attrs.name: structure_permutation_sensitive
attrs.head: work/corpus understanding
attrs.body: structure is real only if permutation-sensitive — shuffling the passages must break the shape signature; reorder-invariance proves there is no structure

attrs.name: worldview_fixed_point
attrs.head: work/corpus understanding
attrs.body: the worldview holds iff every work operator applied to it returns it unchanged (zero displacement); a passage that displaces it is a worldview crack

attrs.name: genre_membership_ci
attrs.head: work/corpus understanding
attrs.body: a work is in-genre iff its (structure,theme,worldview) signature falls inside the genre centroid spread; outside-by-margin mints a candidate new genre
